children: Lion Copper completed an SEC-compliant technical report summary for its Bear Copper Deposit, supporting a resource estimate of 15.48 billion pounds of copper.
The S-K 1300 report supports the Bear mineral resource estimate and is available on EDGAR as an exhibit to Lion Copper’s quarterly report.
The estimate includes 6.71 billion pounds of contained copper in indicated resources and 8.77 billion pounds in inferred resources.
Bear is contiguous with the Yerington Copper Project in Nevada and adds a resource to Lion Copper’s broader district development strategy.
Lion Copper is advancing Yerington through a definitive feasibility study and permitting, with DFS publication targeted for Q1 2027.
Potential use of infrastructure planned for Yerington at Bear remains subject to further technical evaluation and its availability and suitability.

title: Lion Copper Completes S-K 1300 Report for Bear Deposit, Documenting 15.48B Pounds of Copper
